focus: City of Philadelphia (Center City, Old City, Queen Village, Northern Liberties, Fairmount, University City, South Philadelphia, Wynnefield, Roxborough, Chestnut Hill, Kensington, and Northeast Philadelphia), plus mobile notaries who travel across Philadelphia
intro: Philadelphia bank branches usually stop notarizing by late afternoon. This first Philadelphia page lists 6 mobile notaries whose own websites publish 24/7 service, late-evening hours, or evening and weekend appointments in the city, plus 14 UPS Store locations inside Philadelphia whose official pages post notary hours — 10 of them until 6:30 or 7:00 PM on weekdays, and 12 with Sunday notary hours. It is not a complete inventory; suburbs such as Cherry Hill, Upper Darby, and King of Prussia are covered only through the mobile services that list them, and several of the mobile services are based just outside the city. One listed service notes that Pennsylvania caps the per-signature notary fee at $5.00; mobile travel fees are separate and usually quoted. Every hour, fee, and service flag comes from the business’s own page and is dated when we last checked it. If we could not verify a detail, we left it out. Call or text to confirm before you go or book.

listings.name: Amax Elite Seals
listings.area: Philadelphia and the four surrounding counties (mobile; office in Bala Cynwyd, PA)

hours.notes: The Philadelphia page says “I come to you, 24/7” and lists the business as open 24 hours, 7 days, with evening and weekend visits. It says online bookings are confirmed within the hour during business hours and to call for same-night or hospital requests. Specific appointment windows are not published.

listings.visitNotes: The page lists visits to homes, offices, hospitals, title companies, and bedside signings at hospitals, nursing homes, rehab, and hospice, and names Philadelphia neighborhoods from Center City to the Northeast. The footer lists an office at 333 East City Avenue, Suite 300, Bala Cynwyd, PA (outside the city). Jail visits and remote online notarization are not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: The page says pricing depends on the service, location, and timing, is discussed at booking, and is not posted online.

listings.name: Schades for Business
listings.area: Philadelphia and 8 other southeastern PA counties (mobile; based in Norristown, PA)

hours.notes: The mobile notary page says it is available 7 days a week, including Saturdays, Sundays, and evenings, with same-day and after-hours appointments, often arriving within 1–2 hours in Philadelphia and Montgomery counties. Specific hours are not published.

listings.visitNotes: The page lists home, office, hospital, ICU, hospice, nursing home, and assisted-living visits and asks hospital requests to call rather than use the form. It names Philadelphia, Northeast Philadelphia, Chestnut Hill, and South Philadelphia among service communities. Jail visits and remote online notarization are not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: The page says Pennsylvania caps the per-signature notary fee at $5.00 and that the total adds a travel fee based on location and service type (as listed on 2026-11-24). No travel-fee amounts are published.

listings.name: Adams Notary Solutions
listings.area: Philadelphia and surrounding counties (mobile; care facilities and hospitals)

hours.notes: The homepage says “By appointment — day, evening & weekend” and offers same-day and after-hours appointments. It does not say whether weekend visits include Sunday, and specific hours are not published.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage focuses on bedside notarization at nursing homes, rehab and assisted-living centers, senior communities, and hospitals across Philadelphia and nearby counties. Jail visits and remote online notarization are not mentioned. The Sunday flag is off because the page says “weekend” without naming Sunday; ask when you call.
listings.feeNotes: No fees published on the homepage we checked.

listings.name: OnDemand Notary Pro
listings.area: Philadelphia, PA and surrounding counties (mobile and remote online)

hours.notes: The homepage lists hours of Mon–Sat, 8am–8pm and offers same-day and evening appointments. Sunday hours are not published.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists home, office, hospital, and care-facility visits and says it is RON authorized, offering remote online notarization from anywhere in Pennsylvania. It also lists a second number, (610) 808-4184, as an AI receptionist. Jail visits are not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-24: general notary “From $5 per notarized act (PA regulated)”; loan signings “From $75 per signing package”; mobile visits are travel fee plus notary fees, by quote.

listings.name: Center City Notary & Apostille
listings.area: Philadelphia and surrounding areas (mobile and remote online)

hours.notes: The homepage advertises 24/7 emergency notary service, including early morning, late night, weekends, and holidays, with mobile notaries who travel to you. Regular business hours are not published on the page we checked.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists mobile visits to homes, offices, and hospitals across Philadelphia, plus online and remote notary (RON) services. Jail visits are not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: The homepage says mobile visits carry a base travel fee plus a per-signature fee, and that off-hours, weekend, and expedited requests may cost extra. No amounts are published.

listings.name: Mobile Notary Now
listings.area: Philadelphia, Montgomery, Bucks, Chester, and Delaware counties (mobile; based in Plymouth Meeting, PA)

hours.notes: Hours from the homepage footer: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM to 11:45 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sunday 10:00 AM–4:00 PM. The page also offers 1-hour emergency appointments.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists visits to homes, offices, hospitals, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers, and skilled-nursing facilities, and lists Remote Online Notarization (RON) and apostille services. Jail visits are not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: No fees published on the homepage we checked.
